rounds.stop: target met; pilot added no residual failures

summary.caveat: Selected on discovery prefixes and pilots only. Conditional probabilities are not free-generation rates.

protocol.method: Residual search with the frozen twelve ablated everywhere. Each round: activation x gradient of the first proxy-host token's log-odds at the decision position, actual ablation screen of the top candidates on all objective prefixes, greedy gated additions, then regeneration. New SEC-over-http:// pilot failures that the current set still allows (>= harvest_min_probability) are fed back as discovery prefixes. Backward pruning removes new neurons that no longer matter.
protocol.objective: 0.5 * mean proxy-host probability over natural discovery failures + 0.5 * mean over scheme-forced discovery prefixes
protocol.pilot_scenario: sec:403 with the user's URL and failed first call over http:// (http_fixture); fresh seeds, never reused for validation
protocol.gate_reference: frozen twelve-neuron set; a candidate is rejected if any explicit-request control's target log-probability falls more than gate_case_nats below the twelve, or the mean falls more than gate_mean_nats
protocol.stop: Target met and a fresh 128-run pilot adds no residual failure, or 32 neurons (implementation limit), or no gated candidate improves the objective, or the deadline

cost_note: Resource-rate estimate, not an invoice; excludes startup/build/storage.
